digest.component_or_area: test design standards and convergence test authoring
propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive the send path using helper composition instead of capturing the real call site remain green when the send path drifts, defeating their purpose.
A stale re-derived model in test_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py masked send-path changes to AdfCodec.fit_outbound and caused 836 unmarked duplicate comments in live Jira.
A fix to add_comment that replicated the re-derived composition structure passed Gerrit CI verification despite reintroducing the original mistake, caught only by the captured oracle approach.

The rule that convergence/agreement tests must capture external effects from the real call site—not re-derive them by recomposing production helpers—must be documented in shared test-design guidance to prevent recurrence.

Syntactic lint checks cannot reliably distinguish the defective re-derived shape from sanctioned characterization tests that intentionally call both helpers on both sides of assertions, so the rule must remain authoring guidance rather than automated enforcement.
